memories.content: The MCP Vault Admin Console must remain LAN-only.
New MCP Vault backend services use Rust stable 1.94.
MCP Vault finished phase 2; the next project phase is phase 3 integration.
On the Atlas-zh dataset with E5-small and chunk size 512, configuration B achieved the best Recall@5 in this experiment; it is not a universal best.
The owner prefers dark mode for administration dashboards.
The installation master key must be backed up separately from ordinary backups.
WebDAV writes use If-Match or another revision precondition and never silently overwrite a known concurrent change.
The weekly project review is Tuesday at 09:30 Asia/Shanghai.
The local evaluation environment serves Qwen3 through Ollama at http://127.0.0.1:11434.
记忆正文应保留来源语言，不要自动翻译成英文。
A Provider response-body failure after HTTP success must not be automatically replayed because the call may already be billable.
Release 0.1.22 is preparing the source-owned memory-set migration.
